mapper.select:
select distinct concat_WS(' ',e.firstname,e.middlename,e.lastname) empName, ti.tcId tcId,ti.empId,tdd.activityId,tdd.projectId,ai.activity,tdi.workingDay,tdi.workingDate,e.empCode,e.email from TimecardInfo ti,TimecardDayInfo tdi,TimecardDayDetails tdd,ActivitiesInfo ai,EmployeeInfo e
upper(ai.activity)=upper(#{activity}) and
concat(e.firstName,e.middleName,e.lastName) like #{empName} and
recordType='Active' and
tdd.projectId=#{projectId} and
e.empCode = #{empCode} and
ti.weekStart >=#{weekStart} and
ti.weekEnd <=#{weekEnd} and
e.email =#{email} and
ti.tcId=tdi.tcId and tdi.tcId=tdd.tcId and tdi.tcdId=tdd.tcdId and e.empId=ti.empId and ai.activityId=tdd.activityId
